title: [review] piv_len > 0 used as proxy for unprotect success in keys + oscore respond guards
description: P2 latent. coap_keys.c:281,293,306,320,335,347,360,370,380,391,441 and coap_oscore.c:98 guard protected-response selection on piv_len>0 instead of tracked unprotect status. Safe today because oscore_protect.c:400 and coap_oscore.c:194 reject 0-length PIV (canonical-PIV convention), but if the rule is ever relaxed every branch silently degrades to UNPROTECTED lichen_coap_respond fallback, leaking response codes/key-presence in cleartext for OSCORE requests. Fix: track unprotect success in a bool set on r==OSCORE_OK; use that for the guard, in handlers and in coap_oscore_respond_resource.
